facts.text: Wallace's tipple once the gnomes go rogue.
facts.why: Wallace is shown with tea and the old teapot, and the transcript has no beer or pub scene, so 'his tipple' is unbacked; the fix keeps the pint but makes it a plain joke.
facts.fix: What Wallace needs after the gnomes go rogue.

vibe.verdict: Right house, right gadgets and the right villain, but the food leans on cheese and tea and skips the film's set pieces.
